//: The `src/dom` layer: what the bindings share and no framework owns. It needs the DOM lib because a field's props are DOM attributes and `inputTypeFor` returns DOM input type names, which is the one thing `./core` cannot widen to without giving up its own claim. It needs no JSX factory, and `types: []` keeps @types/react out of ambient scope — but `types` does not stop an explicit `import ... from "react"`, so the rule that this layer names no framework is checked by test/framework-free-layers.test.mjs, not by tsc. It is not an entry point: nothing in `exports` reaches it, and `./react` re-exports every public name that moved here.
